text:
maggie: Quick sync — posting the acceptance proposal for Console Observability so we can lock scope for next sprint. TL;DR: 3 dashboards (Latency/Cost/Error), 2 tracing hooks (request+kv-cache), and an error-analysis panel. Can we agree canary & rollout criteria?
simon: Thanks — looks reasonable. Do we have concrete canary thresholds?
maggie: Proposal: 95th latency < 250ms for hot routes, error rate < 0.2% increase vs baseline, and cost per 10k tokens within +10% of current. Canary window = 4 hours, traffic ramp 5/20/50/100%.
tereza: Agree on metrics but want an explicit signal for KV cache hit-rate — if hit-rate drops >5% we rollback. Also need sampling config for traces (1/100 requests for non-enterprise, 1/10 for enterprise customers).
aaron: +1. Who owns dashboard templates vs infra hooks?
maggie: Product will own dashboard designs and queries, eng-runtime will own tracing hooks and sampling endpoints. Owners: @maggie (dashboards), @simon (tracing hooks), @tereza (canary runbook + SRE checklist).
eng-sre-bot: deploy scheduled: canary job will run on dedicated pool; alert: canary-failure if any threshold breached.
devrel: Customer ask: AcmeHealth wants per-tenant cost breakout in GA. Is that in-scope?
simon: Not for initial GA — we can include per-tenant cost as alpha toggle (opt-in) and prioritize early in next milestone.
maggie: Final decisions to confirm: 1) Include KV hit-rate alert (yes). 2) Sampling defaults (1/100 non-enterprise). 3) Canary thresholds above. If no objections by EOD, we'll freeze scope and add stories.
tereza: I'll write the canary playbook and post it here by tomorrow.
aaron: I'll prep dashboard mocks and share link.
maggie: Great — rolling to sprint planning after freeze. :thumbsup:
